decision: User explicitly retained Show Grid in 0.9.4 and requested continued research. No deferral or requirement relaxation.

read_only_zoom_probe.scope: One guarded owned Composition view, ordinary Dev16. Reading zoom does not establish a drawing surface, pan offset, image rectangle, playback synchronization or multi-view support.

historical_callback_reanalysis.interval_semantics: Deselect script timestamp inclusive until select script timestamp exclusive; includes transitions, not a stationary-only proof.
historical_callback_reanalysis.conclusion: No idle Comp callback in this recorded deselected interval from which to call PF_InvalidateRect with a current borrowed context. Layer DRAW cannot supply the missing Comp context; invalidation is valid only during non-draw effect events. No redraw probe built; no retained context or out-of-callback drawing.

static_findings.async_manager: AE_GeneralPlug.h5449: acquired via PF_GetContextAsyncManager; PF_Event_DRAW specific, not an independent overlay registration.
static_findings.native_window: PF platform MAIN_WND Windows only; artisan window functions need renderer/query context.
static_findings.scripting: Documented zoom query is available; inspected View/Viewer/ViewOptions API does not document pan origin or image viewport bounds.
static_findings.accessibility: Current Cua AX observation exposes application window/menu only, no composition canvas node; no new OS permissions or alternative UI reader used.

next_gate: Find a supported additive drawing registration and a current per-view image-to-screen transform that survives deselection and playback. Before production implementation prove a bounded isolated prototype with pan/zoom/multiple-view and export/cache exclusion on both platforms.
